title: Simons' theorem B.2 for smooth stable minimal hypercones, 2 ≤ m ≤ 6: the second fundamental form vanishes (Simon Appendix B, B.4–B.11 and the printed proof of B.2; parent steps 5–9)
statement: Simons' theorem (Simon B.2) for smooth cones. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P; ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Hypotheses: 2 ≤ m ≤ 6; dim A₀ = m + 1; M ⊆ A₀; 0 ∉ M; M is an embedded C^r m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P for every r ∈ ℕ; closure(M) ⊆ M ∪ {0}; tx ∈ M for every x ∈ M and t > 0; H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P; M is stationary away from 0: ∫_M div_M X dH^m = 0 for every C¹ X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with compact support and 0 ∉ tsupport X (div_M X(x) := trace(P_x∘DX(x)), P_x the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x)); ν is C^∞ on some open set O ⊇ M, and for every x ∈ M, ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1, ν(x)·v = 0 for all v ∈ tangentSpace M x, and trace(P_x∘Dν(x)) = 0; and the stability inequality B.1 holds: ∫_M |A|²ζ² dH^m ≤ ∫_M |∇^Mζ|² dH^m for every ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ that is locally Lipschitz on M and vanishes on M outside some compact subset of M, where |A|²(x) := Σ_{j=1}^P |Dν(x)(P_xe_j)|², |∇^Mζ|²(x) := Σ_{j=1}^P (fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x (P_xe_j))², e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1, H^m = μHE[m] (Bochner integrals). Conclusion: Dν(x)v = 0 (fderiv ℝ ν x v = 0) for every x ∈ M and every v ∈ tangentSpace M x.
